findings: exportTargetFavorites uses nullable openFileDescriptor(uri,w)?.use then unconditionally reports success. A null descriptor writes nothing but still produces the exported-count toast. No ContentResolver execution was performed.

Favorite import reads the entire stream with readText and parses JSONArray without byte/item limits. optString coerces entries instead of enforcing string-only schema; paths have no version/schema or canonicalization check here. Existing paths are merged, not replacing all favorites.

Export existence filtering omits missing favorites; import passes through existing path checks and stores paths via previously reviewed comma-separated preferences, so JSON escaping does not fix comma-containing path persistence.

resetProcessedMediaIds returns early when processedMediaPaths is empty even if permanentlySortedFolders is nonempty; the reset implementation would clear both, so this guard can make permanent-only history unreachable through this action.

Similarity threshold change clears persisted results before saving preference but does not cancel an active scan or clear the DuplicatesViewModel in-memory validatedCache. Old scan results can be republished; scheduling remains untested.

Scan include/exclude edits read StateFlow.value, mutate a copy and replace the full preference set. Concurrent calls before flow propagation can lose additions/removals. Scope changes do not clear prior results here.
Index status refresh and full scan set busy flags without try/finally or overlapping-job guards. Exceptions can leave flags true; status and unindexed paths are sampled separately.

App resume dismisses default-path/history search dialogs but not the scope-folder search dialog. FolderSearchManager is shared within this ViewModel, retaining the previously reviewed preparation/reset race.
